characterization_methods: time of flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (TOFSIMS)
evidence: The composition of Lu xAl2/C0 xO3 was monitored by x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) on a Theta 300 XPS system from ThermoFisher... The layer thickness and refractive index were measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry on an Aleris instrument from KLATencor... The density of the ALD layers was determined by x-ray reﬂectivity (XRR). XRR measurements were performed on a Jordan Valley, Inc. BedeMetrix TM-L tool... The C contamination of the layers was extracted by time of flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (TOFSIMS), which uses an IONTOF IV instrument... In order to determine the electrical characteristics, capacitors were formed by evaporation of a 50 nm Pt shadow mask gate... Capacitancevoltage (CV) and Current-voltage (IV) were measured using a Keithley 4200.
